chapter.verse: Topa phat un. I Pasian inn huang sung, Topa ’ inn sunga a ding, Topa ’ nasemte aw, Topa ’ min phat un, a min phat un!
Topa phat un, bang hang hiam cih leh Topa hoih hi; ama min phatna lasak un, bang hang hiam cih leh phat nop huai hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in ama adingin Jakob teel a, ama neihsa dingin Israel teel khin ta hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa lian hi, ci-in ka thei a, eite’ Topa pen pasian khempeuh sangin lianzaw hi.
Vantung leh leitung, tuipi leh a thukna sung khempeuhah Topa in ama ut peuhpeuh a bawl hi.
Amah in leimong panin meiipi kai sakin, guahzuk nadingin khuaphialepte bawl a, ama saalte panin huih pusuak sak hi.
Amah in, Izipt gam sungah mihing leh ganhing tacil khempeuh vatmai hi;
Izipt aw, nangma sungah, lim leh nalamdangte, Faro leh a nasem khempeuhte daan piakna-in a lak hi;
minam tampite vatmai-in kumpi vangliante that a,
Amor kumpipa Sihon, Bashan kumpipa Og leh Kanaan kumpipa that hi.
Amau leitang khempeuh, ama mi Israelte’ luah dingin a piakhia hi.
Topa aw, nangma min kip tawntung hi, Topa aw, nangma minthan’na khang tawntungin a kip hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh Topa in ama mite’ thu khenin, ama nasemte tungah hehpihna nei ding hi.
Minamte’ milimte pen mihingte’ khut tawh a kibawl, ngun leh kham ahi hi.
Amaute in kam nei uh a, ahih hangin amaute pau thei lo uh hi, amaute in mit nei uh a, ahih hangin amaute in khua mu thei lo uh hi,
amaute in bil nei uh a, ahih hangin amaute in khua za thei lo uh hi, amaute’ kam sungah naksuk naktohna theihna nei lo uh hi.
Milim a bawl mite pen milimte mah bangsak in!—milim a muang khempeuhte zong tua milimte mah bangsak in!
Israel mite aw, Topa phat un! Aaron’ innkuante aw, Topa phat un!
Levi mite aw, Topa phat un! Topa a zahtakte aw, Topa phat un!
Jerusalem inn-a a nei, Zion-a om Topa in thupha ngah ta hen! Topa phat un!
